text.en:
In the library Sana spun a big globe slowly. Big patches of land sat in the blue sea.
"These huge land masses are continents," said the librarian. "Count them."
Sana counted seven.

A continent is a very large body of land. There are seven continents: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia (Oceania).
Asia is the largest continent and India is part of it. Australia is the smallest. Antarctica is covered by thick ice and almost nobody lives there permanently.
Continents are surrounded by oceans. The five oceans are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. The Pacific is the largest.
A continent is a very large body of land. There are seven of them.
They are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia.
Asia is the largest and Australia is the smallest. India is in Asia.
Antarctica is covered with ice. The Pacific is the largest ocean.

problem.en: On which continent is India, and is that the largest or the smallest continent?

text.en: India is in the continent of Asia.

why.en: It is bigger than all the others.

text.en: So India is in the largest continent.

prompt.en: A friend says India is a continent. How will you correct this?

requiredIdeas.en: India is a country in the continent of Asia.
A continent is far bigger and has many countries.

points.en: Asia is the largest and Australia the smallest.
